SELECT MAX(team.can_manage_students) AS canManageStudents, MAX(team.can_export) AS canExport FROM edu_course_teacher team JOIN edu_course_space course ON course.id = team.course_space_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding binding ON binding.course_space_id = course.id WHERE binding.teaching_class_id = #{classId} AND binding.ended_at IS NULL AND binding.published_at <= NOW(3) AND course.deleted_at IS NULL AND course.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND team.user_id = #{userId} AND team.ended_at IS NULL AND HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT course.owner_user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, d.dept_name AS deptName, 'OWNER' AS teamRole, 1 AS canManageStudents, 1 AS canExport, u.status AS status FROM edu_course_space course LEFT JOIN v_identity_user u ON u.user_id = course.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN v_identity_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE course.id = #{courseId} AND course.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT team.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, d.dept_name, 'TEACHER', team.can_manage_students, team.can_export, u.status FROM edu_course_teacher team LEFT JOIN v_identity_user u ON u.user_id = team.user_id LEFT JOIN v_identity_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE team.course_space_id = #{courseId} AND team.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY teamRole, userId

UPDATE edu_course_class_binding SET ended_at = GREATEST(NOW(3), TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, 1000, published_at)), ended_by_user_id = #{operatorId}, end_reason = '教师删除教学班' WHERE course_space_id = #{courseId} AND teaching_class_id = #{classId} AND ended_at IS NULL
